touches.text: Summarizes when asked. Its chat pane is its face.

A bare `cairn librarian` never prints URLs. It (1) launches the librarian's shim, which (2) parses the request (nothing) and so (3) launches the librarian and (4) launches a browser pointed at the librarian's chat page. That http request arrives at the web server's shim, which launches the web server, which displays the librarian's page with focus on the chat window. Each part is self-initializing (5.3.5).
PURPOSE: Python sieves run over a build; reds a component that fails one (no charter, no proofs, a silent device, ...). "We find a new thing, we add a new sieve."
Logging and diagnostics, including diagnostic_inspector: the smart reader of the dumb breadcrumbs base's logging leaves; complete diagnosis on the first pass.
